groups.name: cm5_core
groups.why: the CM5's two board-to-board connectors (declared poses, one origin) with their strap parts: R102/R103 select GPIO_VREF (0R to +3V3 or +1V8), R104 pulls EEPROM_nWP down, CN1 is the RTC battery (+BATT to Module301 pin 76); the +3V3_PI and GND test points probe the module's rails; C101/C102 (100n on +5V) decouple the module's +5V input pins (Module301 77-87)

groups.name: power_in
groups.why: USB-C power input J101 (VBUS = +5V, also the CM5's USB2 OTG/boot port via /USB_C.D) with its ESD clamp D101, the +5V bleeder R101 and the VBUS/+5V test points

groups.name: ethernet
groups.why: RJ45 with magnetics J1 (mid-mount, in the west notch), its two ESD arrays U401/U402 on the TRD pairs, the LED resistors R401/R402, the shield 0R R403 and the magnetics centre-tap cap C401

groups.name: usb_host
groups.why: USB-C host port USB701: ESD D701 on D+/D-, CC source pull-ups R702/R703, the VBUS current-limit switch U701 with its ILIM resistor R701, its input cap C701 and the VBUS bulk/output caps C702/C703

groups.name: hdmi
groups.why: HDMI0 receptacle J501 with its three ESD arrays (TMDS D401/D402, DDC/CEC/HPD D403 on the back) and the HDMI +5V power switch U405 with its input/output caps C501/C502

groups.name: m2

templates.why: AP3441 1 MHz synchronous buck, +5V to M2_3V3 for the M.2 card; datasheet has no layout figure, the Diodes AP3441/L EVB user guide board view is the layout

groups.why: M.2 M-key socket J701 (declared, with its 2230/2242 standoffs) and its 3.3 V supply: the AP3441 buck U702 with CIN C704/C705/C706, inductor L701, COUT C708-C711 + C712, feedback divider R705/R706 with feed-forward C707, EN pull-down R704; the 32.768 kHz SUSCLK oscillator U703 and the activity LED D702/R707

groups.name: camera
groups.why: 22-pin 0.5 mm FPC camera connector J802 (CSI DPHY0 from Module302)

groups.name: io
groups.why: the user I/O connectors: Qwiic I2C J502 with its ESD D502 and pull-ups R501/R502, the LIS3DH accelerometer U1 on that bus (on the back) with its strap resistors R107/R108 and decap C503, the SPI display connector J503 and its 3V3 bulk C601, and the fan connector J601

groups.name: ui
groups.why: power button SW501, boot button SW101 (back), the power LED D605 with its inverter U602 and resistor R605, and the activity LED D606/R606; the source put the buttons 4-5 mm from the east edge, near the module's PWR_BUT/nRPIBOOT pins
